text: Triple Hammer Strike - Heroic Dungeon S2

Resonates with the power from Elite Boarrier Tyrant. Continuously maintains Tusk Charge status for <style="accent-gn">3s</style>. Deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and knocks back enemies during the charge, with gradual directional control throughout. Boarrier tusks tear through flesh, inflicting <style="accent-gn">100%</style> <linktext=3004><style="ItemQuality_5">Wound</style></linktext> on enemies hit for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>.

Consumes 5 Ice Energy to instantly summon 3 Meteor Storms above the target, dealing Magic Damage to the target and surrounding enemies.
This skill holds 2 charges.

Tips: This instant-cast DMG skill is best utilized in a highly mobile style of combat to maximize DMG dealt through repeated use.

Launches into enemy lines, dealing Attack DMG to enemies in range and knocking them Airborne. Restores 100 Courage.
"Endless storm, unlock thy mighty power at my knight's command! Wind, reveal thy glory with a surging rush!"

Tips: Cast when Courage is low.

Consumes 20 Energy to summon a giant vine that strikes a target area, dealing Magic DMG and healing the caster and the nearby ally with the lowest HP (Party Members Prioritized). Healing grows with MATK.

Use on demand in emergencies. For better results, pair with offensive skills to trigger Symbiotic Marks and boost effectiveness.

Oblivion Combo
A supreme sword technique sharp enough to cut the air itself. Unleashes a flurry of slashes in front, dealing Attack DMG to all enemies in range. Grants max Thunder Sigil and fully restores Blade Intent at the end of the strike.
"Heaven's weapon dims even the brightest stars."

Tips: Cast when Thunder Sigil is empty to quickly charge it. Also effective against multiple targets for massive area damage.

Quickly slashes horizontally with a scythe condensed from lightning, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">400%</style> ATK to the enemy, which scales with the Level/Tier of <style="accent-gn">Thundercut</style>.

Thunder Zone
launches into the air and fires a Thunderstorm Bolt at the target. On hit, it deals Thunder DMG and creates a Thunderstorm Zone lasting 7s.
Thunderstorm Zone
deals AoE Thunder DMG every second to all enemies within the range, with a Slow debuff.

Pro Tips: This skill can be cast while airborne, granting enhanced mobility during execution.

Erects an immovable rock wall and enter a defensive stance, taunting nearby monsters and becoming invincible. Blocking a Lethal Skill causes the wall to shatter and counterattack the target, dealing Attack DMG to all the enemies in front.

Tips: Ultimate tank skill, perfect for absorbing extreme DMG.

Consumes 40 points of Rage, violently slams down the weapon, dealing Attack DMG to surrounding enemies, and enters the Countercrush state. During this time, Block Chance +100%, Attack DMG taken from blocks -30%.

Tips: Very effective in environments with mostly Attack DMG. After casting, the block chance increases, reliably reducing Attack DMG taken.

Resonates with the power from Boss Tempest Ogre. Channels the power of thunder, summoning a thunder vortex that continuously pulls nearby enemies. After its duration ends, deals area <style="magic">Magic DMG</style>.

Swings your guitar with force, dealing Magic DMG equal to 300% ATK to nearby enemies. Harmonic Anthem instantly gains 1 charge. Scales with the Level/Tier of Basic Attack.

Tips: Cast this skill when Harmonic Anthem is on CD.

Holy Sigil
Resource required to cast Special Attacks and some Expertise. There are 5 initial Holy Sigils. Each Holy Sigil enters a 10s CD after being consumed, and generates 10 Photon Energy.

Photon Energy
Resource required to cast some Expertise, starting at a max of 100.

Basic Attack: Blade of Justice
Unleashes a 3-hit sword combo followed by a Swing, each hit dealing Attack DMG.

Creates a holy zone beneath your feet, healing yourself every second and healing allies in the area slightly, dealing Attack DMG to enemies.

Tips: Great for sustained DMG and healing. Try to cover as much area as possible.

Consumes 3 Holy Sigils, summoning a sword from beneath the target's feet to deal Attack DMG to the target, while gaining 5 stacks of Lightforged Barrier.

Lightforged Barrier: Each stack increases the final Max HP by 2%. You can have up to 10 stacks of Lightforged Barrier, and any damage taken will consume 1 stack. It lasts for 25s or until all stacks are consumed, and the duration resets each time a stack is gained.

Tips: While having considerable damage capability, it can efficiently replenish Lightforged Barrier.

Releases an energy wave, interrupting all targets within 5m.

This skill is unaffected by CD effects.

<style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Airona. After a brief cast, revives up to <style="accent-gn">4</style> nearby teammates. <style="accent-gn">Weakness: Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s (Weakness effects are enhanced in party dungeons of Nightmare mode).</style>

<style="accent-gn">Summons</style> Olvera to shuttle back and forth in a forward direction, drawing in enemies encountered along the path, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>, and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> their actions. When dealing DMG, there is a chance to inflict Seed of Lightning on the targets for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>. Dealing DMG to targets with Seed of Lightning will cause an explosion (CD: <style="accent-gn">2s</style>), dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style>. Any target with Seed of Lightning defeated will reduce CD time by <style="accent-gn">20s</style>.

[Elite Summon] - Axe Muku. Deals Attack DMG, reducing the target's ATK for 10s.
[Non-stackable. Only one effect of the same type may be active]

Summons Elite: Lizardman Hunter to chant briefly, dealing Magic DMG.
Upon the skill cast, your Luck and Lucky Strike Chance are increased for a period.

Summons Boss: Rebel King to deal Attack DMG.
After casting, temporarily grants full passive stacks, with the effect multiplied by 2.

Transform into Celestial Spirit Mage - Lucy, replacing your skill set while gaining Ability Conversion.
Passive: Dealing damage converts 50% of the damage dealt into healing for up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates).
1. Fleuve d'Étoiles: Manifests the Fleuve d'Étoiles and swings it continuously, dealing Light Magic DMG to targets.
2. Celestial Guardian: Harnesses the power of Celestial Spirits to grant a shield lasting 20s to up to 10 allies within range (prioritizing teammates). Simultaneously inflicts debuffs on up to 5 enemies within range, reducing ATK, applying Vulnerability, and reducing Element Resistance for 10s.
3. Aqua Metria: Draws upon the power of Aquarius to unleash waves forward, dealing Water Magic DMG to targets in their path, with an additional 50% of the damage dealt converted into healing.
Enter magnetic mode after activation. When close to another floating eye ball in magnetic mode, you can instantly attach to it and move synchronously with the target!
Enter magnetic mode after activation. When close to another floating eye ball in magnetic mode, you can instantly attach to it and move synchronously with the target!
A tail flick launches a water pillar skyward! The koi rides the water and leaps high into the sky.

Go wild! My inspiration is sparking! Paints graffiti coins ahead. Picking them up grants special effects.

Graffiti Coin: Reduces the CD of Nitro Acceleration by 30% and briefly increases Movement SPD.
Dashes forward a certain distance and gains increased Movement Speed.
Transforms into a shadow of the night and moves forward. Holds up to 3 charges.

Makes the user gigantic for 15s.
Movement generates shockwaves, dealing high damage to nearby Stalkers.
While gigantic, movement speed is reduced and skills cannot be used.
"Drive them out! Every last one of them!"

Projects a copy of a similar item and restores 40 HP.
Projecting a new copy removes the previous item.
"Projection, start!"
